result.summary: Found 1 critical issue: an untranslated localization key is displayed as a section title.

issues.description: The section header displays the raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of the intended human-readable title (e.g., 'Popular near you').
issues.suggestion: Ensure the localization string for the key 'home_feed.popular_title' is properly defined and rendered so it shows translated text instead of the raw key.
